messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert — p99 latency jumped to 9.8s for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Error rate (5xx) up from 0.2% to 4.7% in last 2m. Triggered paging to @eng-sre-oncall and @rebecca
rebecca: I'm on it. seeing the alert graphs in grafana. canary deploy went out ~3m ago?
ajay: yes canary started at 5951234000, 10% traffic. I pushed a kernel tweak for the runtime; same deploy id: dp-2026-03-15-ker-89
rebecca: ok, verify canary only or global?
ajay: traffic router showed canary still at 10% but spike in tail latency for both canary and baseline pods — odd.
eng-sre-oncall: paging in — grabbing logs. can we get a quick curl sample hitting the gateway?
maria: running quick curl loop from lab to reproduce. output: 
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -w "%{time_total} %{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate; done
# results: several ~0.2s, some 8-12s, a couple 504
```
ken: seeing a few 502s in the gateway logs too. piling up connection reset errors between gateway and runtime.
rebecca: checking runtime logs for KV cache pressure and OOMs.
ops: autoscaler hasn't tripped. infra metrics look fine. GPU-util steady.
ajay: here's a snippet from runtime: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:47Z] WARN eviction: kvcache miss spike=0.24, inflight=120
[2026-03-15T12:02:48Z] ERROR request: stall detected seq=1024 timeout=10000ms trace=abc123
[2026-03-15T12:02:49Z] ERROR connection: downstream reset by peer
```
eng-sre-oncall: kvcache miss spike + inflight queues = likely head-of-line blocking. could be kernel tweak interacting poorly with batching.
rebecca: can we route canary to a separate host pool and isolate? emergency route-shift?
ajay: yes we can flip weights to 0 for canary in the router. command: `routerctl set-weight dp-2026-03-15-ker-89 0`
maria: doing it now. set-weight returned OK. verifying metrics...
incident-bot: routerctl: weight change applied. Canary traffic -> 0% at 5951237201.
rebecca: monitoring p99 now.
rebecca: p99 dropped to 1.1s after canary pulled. error rate down to 0.4%. good.
customer-svc: CX reported a handful of timeouts for power users, around 11:58–12:04. only a small fraction flagged but some API retries failed. ticket created INC-4221.
ken: was the deploy rolled forward after canary? I see dp-2026-03-15-ker-89 was promoted at 5951236000 to 50% for a brief window then auto-synced?
ajay: hmm I didn't promote. checking deploy-bot logs...
deploy-bot: autopromote: dp-2026-03-15-ker-89 -> promoted to 50% at 5951236065 due to routing policy emergency threshold mis-eval. manual rollback available.
rebecca: ugh autopromote triggered. that explains the broader impact.
eng-sre-oncall: immediate mitigation: roll back the runtime change globally and re-instate previous kernel. rollback command: `deployctl rollback dp-2026-03-15-ker-89 --to dp-2026-03-15-ker-88`
ajay: executing rollback now. tailing progress: 
```
Rolling back dp-2026-03-15-ker-89 -> dp-2026-03-15-ker-88
Scaling new pods up: 6 -> 6
Cordon canary nodes
Drain in-flight requests with grace 15s
```
ops: scaling changes applied; new pods come up healthy.
incident-bot: rollback started at 5951237600.
rebecca: after rollback p99 stable at ~0.9s, error rate back to baseline 0.18%. Gateway 502/504s gone.
maria: collecting perf counters for postmortem. snapshotting flamegraphs and kernel env.
ken: customer impact estimate: ~0.8% of requests in window saw timeout or 5xx, small number of customers experienced failed flows (retries didn't hide). flagging as Sev-2 pending more CX detail.
customer-svc: notifying top affected accounts, offering expedited support.
eng-sre-oncall: quick root-cause hypothesis: the kernel tweak reduced batch eviction aggressiveness but increased KV-inflight leading to head-of-line stalls under certain skewed sequences. autopromote then pushed it to more traffic exposing the issue.
rebecca: action items for now:
- disable autopromote until we add a canary safety check (ajay)
- add a gating metric for kvcache miss/inflight (maria)
- run controlled stress test of kernel tweak on staging (ken)
- communicate to customers and update INC-4221 (customer-svc)

ajay: disabling autopromote flag now: `deployctl set-config autopromote=false` -> OK at 5951239002.
maria: opening an eval run to reproduce with targeted seq lengths. will attach artifacts to the incident.
eng-sre-oncall: creating a runbook note: when tail latency >5s and kvcache miss >0.2, route canary to 0 and rollback.
rebecca: handing off to night oncall @ken for watch and postmortem writeup. I'll stay available until handoff completes.
ken: acknowledged. will do a 30m watch and gather more logs, then start the incident timeline draft.
ops: nothing left to scale for now, metrics stable.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) at 5951240000. ongoing monitoring for 1h.
rebecca: post-incident notes: autopromote feature had insufficient gating and allowed a mid-canary promote; we must tighten. Good quick detection and rollback.
customer-svc: sent messages to affected customers, offering credits where appropriate.
eng-sre-oncall: handing off summary to next shift: include timeline, deploy id, commands run, artifacts link: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/incident-5951234567 (attach pending).
rebecca: closing thread but keeping it pinned to incidents channel until postmortem done. thanks all :thumbsup:
